On second thought, maybe Phainon should thank the director of this photoshoot.

Phainon was practically glowing and beaming with joy when he was directed to pose for the magazine’s workout section. Given how easily Phainon could manhandle Mydei in their bed, the model had more than enough arms strength and core strength to stay in a pushup position with Mydei on his back. Phainon was too focused on the thought of Mydei sitting on him that he failed to realize the pose they were making was a very obvious thirst-trap. The person on top of him was not happy about it, his piss-off aura was intimidating enough to scare away anyone that was ogling at Phainon.

“Excellent, excellent! Mydeimos, could you help with this next shot?” Mydei glanced at the director and gave him a nod as he stood up. He only cast a single glance at Phainon who was now sitting, the model immediately looked away when their gazes met, like a guilty puppy.

That was when Cyrene realized there was something wrong between Phainon and Mydei. She was not going to let Phainon escape without an explanation, and Phainon could sense the impending doom from her direction.

chapters.title: Apology and 3rd wheeling
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

A fancy dinner made by Mydei for the price of being a 3rd wheel? Count Cyrene in any day. Oh right, Phainon finally managed to apologized to his Mydei

“Thanks for inviting me over for dinner, Mydei! I seriously can’t get enough of your cooking, care to teach a girl your secrets?” Cyrene was about to skin Phainon alive to make him tell her what happened between the two, but Mydei just happened to intervene at the right time.

Cyrene and Mydei walked side by side and chatted with each other while Phainon trailed behind the blonde with his (invisible) tail dragging on the ground. Phainon offered to drive the two back to his shared house, but Mydei declined his offer, buying ingredients for dinner was his excuse. Cyrene and Mydei stayed inside the lobby while Phainon went to get his car.

“It’s just a little hobby of mine; there’s no secret behind a good meal” Mydei chuckled at the girl. “Well, other than being a hobby, cooking actually help out in way that many wouldn’t even thought of” The man said with an amused tone, offering Cyrene a light smile when she asked about it.

“Saving that stupid lover of mine from being skinned alive by his childhood friends is one of them” Mydei then proceeded to tell Cyrene what Phainon had forgotten about this morning. Before Cyrene could said anything, Mydei also informed her of the other man ridiculous schedule for the past week, assuring her that he wasn’t mad at her childhood friend.

“I know I’m being mean and really unfair to him but think of it as a little revenge for the many times he ignored my request to stop for the night” Mydei said, casually mentioning their love life in front of all the people in the lobby. If the upcoming issue of the magazine didn’t do it, the footage from the security camera and the many eyewitnesses there would be enough to confirm Phainon and Mydei relationship. The two were just too infatuated with each other that they forgot to announce it to the world, for almost two years. As you would expect, the internet was on fire when photos of Mydei leaving the penthouse Phainon was staying in, only to be hit with another fire storm as Phainon confirmed that they were co-habituating during an interview. The great fire of the past will soon be ignited once more when the magazine is released.

Mydei bid Cyrene goodbye when he saw the familiar McLaren parked near the entrance.

---

When Cyrene sat down in the passenger seat, she could see Phainon staring at Mydei as the blonde made his way to his chauffeur. She thought about whether she should tell Phainon about what Mydei said, letting her friend be in so much distress did not sit right with her. Another reason that Cyrene wanted to tell Phainon the truth, was because the man crunched on his breath mint like a psychopath when he was stressed. Hearing Phainon, who was next to her, opening the metal box and popping a candy in his mouth constantly, followed immediately by a crunch. Cyrene would rather be in a horror movie than near this Phainon. Before she could open her mouth, Phainon received a call from none other than the person who he believed was mad at him.

“Mydei! I’m sor- “

“Stop eating breath mints like that, HKS. You’re scaring Cyrene. Be a good boy and go home, alright? I’m not mad at you” And Mydei hung up before Phainon could say anything more, and the car that Mydei entered drove away. Phainon put his phone on in the drink compartment and slid down in his seat, his posture relaxing as he let out a relief smile. Fortunately, Phainon didn’t even suspect that Mydei was messing with him, unfortunately, he now thought that Cyrene had helped him. The girl was too focused on browsing Mydei private social media account, where he posts all his cooking, to notice where Phainon was taking her.

Cyrene looked up to see they were in the parking lot of a high-end Michelin star bakery. As she glanced over to the entrance, her jaw dropped at the long line of people waiting to land a spot inside the restaurant without reservation. Cyrene didn’t know how she should feel as she saw Phainon casually walking through the door, with all the employees greeting him. About 10 minutes later, Phainon walked out with a box in his hand, flashing his signature pretty boy smile when some of the people in line recognized him, followed by many squealing and screaming from the girls.

“Sorry, I couldn’t bring you inside. The place is very strict with their V.I.P partners, only those listed in their V.I.P special guest list could enter with the V.I.P benefit. Mydei’s list only have 2 people, which is me and his mother.” Phainon explained after he put the box in Cyrene’s lap and put on his seat belt.

“Okay, two questions. How did Mydei have a V.I.P in that restaurant? I heard people have to wait for more than a year for their reservation! Second, why did we stop by that place? Mydei is making dinner for us” Cyrene asked as she stared at the extremely bougie looking take-out box on her lap. She didn’t even know the place has take-out, she later found out it was a V.I.P only thing.

From Phainon’s words, the restaurant gained an insane number of customers and popularity when Mydei recommended their Golden Honeycakes during the filming of the behind-the-scenes of Flame-Chase: Strife - The Last Prince. Thanks to the support of the new customers, the owner was able to rebuild the old restaurant and put more resources into perfecting and developing their recipes. Mydei was reluctant at first when the restaurant wanted to put him on their V.I.P list but the owner was insistent. After half a year of constant back and forth between the two, Mydei accepted their offer. Phainon told Cyrene that he also has the same reaction as her when Mydei took them there as part of his 1-year-anniversary-celebration-package.

“And don’t worry, I only bought a few items off their dessert menu. I don’t know if your taste has changed back when we were kids, so I just ordered whatever the chef recommend and Mydei’s favorite”

----

 Only at Phainon and Mydei’s shared home that one could witness a human somehow even more excited than two puppies running toward the door to greet someone. Mydei’s patience transcended the norm for human, Cyrene watched as three big puppies swarming the man asking for his attention. After he managed to land a kiss on Mydei’s face, Phainon grabbed the grocery bag that Mydei was holding and grabbed his now empty hand to lead the man into their kitchen.

On the kitchen island was a plate of perfectly round and fluffy golden honeycakes drizzled with sweet golden syrup, next to it was a cup of pomegranate juice mixed with goat milk, on the rim of the glass was a piece of goat cheese as garnish. Mydei looked over to the person that set it up, and saw the sparkles in his eyes, 100% waiting to be praised/rewarded.

Love hearts were flying out of the kitchen after Snowball and Maple were ushered out of there. Phainon walked out of the kitchen 5 minutes later, his shirt was unbuttoned showing a kiss mark on his collarbone and a line of drool on the corner of his mouth. Cyrene did not want to know who saliva that was, a DNA test would say it belong to both men. The pink-haired girl wondered if a dinner made by Mydei was worth staying there after she heard Phainon said that the French knew what they were doing when it’s came to kissing. 

The delicious smell from the kitchen helped Cyrene make up her mind and she was glad that she stayed. A beautiful cut of lamb chops, with a beautiful sear on the outside and pink on the inside, cooked medium rare just like how Cyrene would refer. As she cut into it, the meat was tender and juicy. A perfect blend of smokiness from the seared crust and a hint of rosemary and butter hit the taste buds as she bit down. The sauce was on another level, it was rich and herbaceous with just the perfect level of tanginess from the lemon zest and red wine.

While Cyrene was in cloud nine with her plate of lamb chops with the creamy and buttery mash potato. Phainon had already polished off half of his piece of medium rare steak, if Cyrene wasn’t here, he would 100% lick up all the Jus on his plate. The sauce had been Phainon’s favorite ever since Mydei introduced it to him on one of their earliest dinner dates. The model used to hate brussels spout, but he had come to realize that the bitterness that he hated could be mellowed out or even removed with a good roast. Every time he had Mydei’s homecooked food, he asked himself why they aren’t married yet.

“Slow down, you glutton. You’re going to choke if you continue to inhale your food like that. Maybe your two puppies aren’t the only one that need to eat from a slow feeder bowl” Mydei teased him, as if his calico cat wasn’t already a round ball of fur. Despite the tease, Mydei still fed Phainon a few spoonsful of his portion. Cyrene pretended that she did not just see Phainon lean over to lick that tiny bit of sauce sticking to the corner of Mydei’s mouth. She thought that she was used to third wheeling her childhood friend, but that man somehow grew bolder every time she saw him with Mydei. Fortunately, the food distracted the girl from whatever lovely-dovely thing Phainon was doing to Mydei.

Cyrene stayed for a while after dinner, chatting with Mydei about work and cooking tips. Phainon tried to join the conversation but was understandably ignored when the topic moved to cooking related matter.  

“The dinner was amazing as always Mydei, thanks for treating me! Have a nice rest of your day” Cyrene bid them goodbye and gave both Snowball and Maple a few head pats before heading to her private ride. When Mydei closed the front door, his cheery lover’s mood immediately shifted.

“Mydei, I’m sorry… I didn’t realize our anniversary was coming up” The overgrown puppy hugged his lover from behind and buried his face into the other’s neck. Despite Mydei already told him that he didn’t mind, Phainon still felt like an asshole for forgetting such an important day. The clingy pup didn’t let go when Mydei started to move elsewhere, sticking to his back like an opossum baby hanging to its mother’s back. Baby opossum then turned into a koala when Mydei hiked Phainon’s legs up to wrap around his torso. Not one for repeating the same thing twice, Mydei just let Phainon “sulked it out”, can’t be spoiling him too much with attention and kisses.

“Mind reaching up and grab me a cup, Phainon?” Phainon gave a small hum as an answer, lifting his face and reaching into the open cupboard to grab a cup.

“Oh and grab the pets’ food too, I think Nea still have one more can of tuna cat food left. For the puppies… let’s see” Mydei opened the freezer – specifically for pet foods and treats, to grab the left-over raw meat from the puppies’ breakfast. “Let give them an egg and some pumpkin puree to go with their raw feed. How does that sound, Phainon?”

“…there’s a little bit of dried sardines left, give them that too… can you ask your assistant to buy more of it?... Both of the puppies really like them” Phainon stayed silent for a while, watching Mydei preparing 3 bowls of food for their pets. It wasn’t a surprise to see or hear all three of the mentioned pets running into the kitchen seconds after Mydei opened Nea’s canned cat food.

“Mydei, can I take you out on a date tomorrow? I know you’re not mad at me but let me do something to make up for it. Please, Mydei?” Phainon finally spoke up again, nuzzling into Mydei’s hair. He let go of Mydei, only to haul the man up the kitchen island behind them to bury his face into Mydei’s soft and voluptuous pecs. Spoiling and pampering Phainon was Mydei’s part-time job, so he naturally let his lover cushion his face on his chest. But Phainon had to let go eventually as 3 hungry pets were whining at his feet for their dinner, Nea – as usual – was very vocal about her need.

“If that stop you from sulking like a kicked puppy, then sure. But not on a date and not tomorrow” Phainon looked up at him, clearly confused and sad that he was rejected. The blonde pressed a kiss on those pouty lips and grabbed Phainon’s chin.

“Let’s go on a little vacation. Away from the upcoming tide that the magazine this morning will definitely bring once it is released in a week or so. Don’t worry, we’ll bring the puppies with us. I’ll arrange for someone to take care of them then. But ultimately, it’s just the two of us, enjoying our anniversary together, on a private island. How does that sound, honeycake?”

Mydei knew Phainon couldn’t say no to him when he looked at him with so much gentleness and fondness. The soft smile on Mydei’s lips when Phainon grabbed his hand to nuzzle into it, titans above Phainon was so far gone for this man.

“Yes.  Anything you want, my one and only star”

“Mmhmm, love you too”

The pets had given up on whining and meowing for their dinner.

chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Phainon didn’t see Mydei at all for an entire week after the man said he wanted to take a vacation. No hugs, no kisses, no head pats, no lap or booba pillows, Phainon was running extremely low on his Mydei energy. His stupid ahoge started wilting after three days.

Phainon didn’t see Mydei at all for an entire week after the man said he wanted to take a vacation. No hugs, no kisses, no head pats, no lap or booba pillows, Phainon was running extremely low on his Mydei energy. His stupid ahoge started wilting after three days.

In reality, Phainon and his ahoge was just being dramatic. Both of them had attuned to each other so much that one cannot function without the other. Mydei can’t sleep without having Phainon’s warmth against his back and Phainon cannot put on his pretty boy smiles and cheery attitude without a cup of coffee specifically made by Mydei.

Mydei still returned to Phainon’s bed every night and made him coffee every morning. Head pats and kisses were also given to the overgrown puppy every morning; he just wasn’t awake at that time. Phainon still have Mydei to cuddle every nights, and the model still mindlessly prepared a bath for Mydei after his own.

The sunshine energy radiating from Phainon was gone on the fifth day, scaring the shit out of everyone that was unfortunate enough to work with the wolf that day. Phainon’s snappy and cranky attitude somehow worked in his favor, making time consuming photoshoots ended in half the time, everyone didn’t want to piss him off by nitpicking on the poses. A short clip of Phainon’s cold gaze and stoic face was posted by another model from a rival agency started circulating around the internet. It was posted with malicious intends towards Phainon’s image and popularity, but it backfired as people was swooning over that “bad boy” face.

An artist made a fan art of that version of Phainon, replacing his usual sun tattoo with a black crescent moon. The internet went crazy over it. The news of Phainon’s new persona reached Mydei, not by the messages sent from his friend but via the director of the movie he was auditioning for. Phainon got an invitation to play as the villain without even auditioning.

Phainon’s mood got worse and worse as the day went on, it had gotten so bad that simply talking to the man only met with growls and glares. The new manager was on the verge of tears when he contacted Mydei to come to the rescue and put his dog taming talent to use.

If Mydei hadn’t seen the video sent by Phainon’s manager, he would have 100% believed that everyone was delusional that day. You would think that too if the supposed wolf that had been growling and snapping at people greeted you with wagging tail and charming smiles. Phainon’s new manager now understood why Aglaea asked him to contact Mydei whenever Phainon was causing trouble.

The new manager looked at his phone for a second and the pair of model and actor already disappeared. Fortunately, he was able to catch a glimpse of red hair disappearing into the corridor leading to Phainon’s designated dressing room for the photoshoot. Curiosity killed the cat. When he peaked into the ajar door of the model’s dressing room, he saw something that he definitely wasn’t supposed to see.

The actor Mydei was sitting on the vanity with Phainon between his legs, the model caging him in with his arms. The two was sharing an intimate kiss, when Phainon new manager peaked into the door. The new manager knew he was doomed when he and Mydei made eye contact. He should have left, but he couldn’t look away, not with how Mydei looked at him with such a mischievous gaze. The actor put a finger over his lips, signaling for the peeping tom to stay quite after Phainon unzipped his jacket and buried his face into Mydei’s neck. He ran when Mydei started unbuckling Phainon’s pants.

After Mydei’s quick pampering session, Phainon saw a message from his new manager 15 minutes ago.

Manager (OvO): The shoot got canceled, so you can go for a walk to clear your head. I’ll go get some tea for you and Mr. Mydei.  Reply when you’re done with your walk.

Me: I’m so sorry for leaving so suddenly! I really need some advice on how to handle my emotions and stress from Mydei, sorry for taking so long!

Manager (OvO): It’s alright. Wouldn’t want the shining star to be over stress. I’ll wait for you in the company car.

The new manager really hoped Phainon didn’t notice him back there, he really wanted to keep his new job. He jumped when he heard Phainon calling out to him. The manager was glad that his talent was back to his usual happy mood. The man greeted the two men, and handed them their drinks, Oolong tea for Phainon and Chamomile tea with honey for Mydei. Thankfully, Phainon didn’t ask any questions about the tea he bought for Mydei.

Phainon was halfway inside the car when he suddenly remembered something, the man bolted while yelling for his manager to wait for him for a little while. Which meant the manager was left alone with Mydei. Soul piercing golden eyes were on him the moment Phainon disappeared, he tried his best not to look at the red marks the actor’s neck. His eyes almost popped out when Mydei lifted up the hem of his shirt, revealing a red handprint on his waist.

“Did Aglaea ever mentioned that there is a price for calling me to deal with him? You have a lot of experience with managing model, so you must be well aware of how troublesome it is to deal with these types of love marks right?” The manager was in fact not informed about the cost of calling Mydei. He apologized profusely for the trouble and promised to compensate Mydei at the end of the month.

“I don’t need money” was Mydei’s curt reply. As a successful actor with dozens of nominated movies that he starred in, not to mention him being in the main cast of the Flame Chase movie series, Mydei was literally swimming in cash.

“And you also saw something that you shouldn’t have seen. But I’m feeling generous today.” Mydei said as he leaned over to whisper to Phainon’s manager

“Make sure no one touches him. If I hear about another rumor about him in a relationship with someone else, I’ll make sure your life is a living hell, got it?”

Before he could open his mouth, more troubles arrived. He could see from the corner of his eyes that Phainon was staring at them. Fortunately, Mydei had already moved to stand up right. Unfortunately, the manager saw the mischievous glint in Mydei’s eyes way too late. He watched in horror as Phainon’s expression darkened when Mydei took a sip of the manager’s tea. The blush that crept up his face when he realized he got an indirect kiss from the one and only Mydei did not paint him in a good light in Phainon’s eyes.

Mydei, seemingly possessed by Zagreus, acted like he only saw Phainon after he tasted the tea in the manager’s hand. The confusion that happened when Phainon’s drink was snatched from his own hand was enough to offset the jealousy and possessiveness inside the white-haired male. Mydei had joinked the cake box Phainon was holding and also his tea, before walking off without a single word.

“P-Phainon, do you need me to chase after him?”

“… I didn’t know I could feel so many emotions in the span of like 5 seconds” Phainon stared at his now every empty hand “My tea…”

“If it makes you feel any better, mine is also gone”

Thankfully nothing related to Mydei was brought up after Phainon sat down inside the car. His manager drove him straight to his house, not wanting another Reaver Phainon incident while they were working with clients. Despite being the one inviting his manager to stay for dinner, Phainon looked way too happy when said person decline the offer. Phainon’s manager needed a raise, he probably lost like 5 years of his life after dealing with a wolf disguised as a puppy and threatened by a lion.

---

Once again, Mydei arrived home with the sight of Phainon passed out on the couch. To think that the person who drooling on his couch was able to make such a scary face, according to Phainon’s manager and client today. In his humble opinion, Mydei found it hot as fuck. The furballs cuddling together on the floor started making noises, barking and meowing, when they saw what their mama was holding. The commotion woke Phainon up as he let out a sleepy grumble. Phainon was a messy sight when he sat up, drooled on his shirt, his hair similar to a bird nest, his shirt all crinkled. Mydei couldn’t help but let out a fond sigh when Phainon tried to push himself up using the empty spaces between the couch and the coffee table, which caused him to fall off the couch. They say love is blind and both Phainon and Mydei are the prime examples of it.

Mydei original plan for that afternoon was to restock their pet’s freezer and fed them, then went for a relaxing bath, but Phainon managed to insert himself into that plan, specifically the latter one. One would think Mydei was making Snowball take a bath with the amount of whining coming from the bathroom, but it was just Phainon being Phainon.

“I haven’t seen you for almost a week… You ignored your boyfriend for almost a week!” The white-haired male mumbled out, sitting and sulking under the running shower. The wet puppy casted a glance at the man trying to decide which shampoo to use.

“You even stole my drink and cake… All I wanted was to bathe with you and you deny me my serotonin… Mydei doesn’t love me anymore… You only want me for my beautiful face, sculpted body and my giant cock that can make you scr- EEKKK!! Mydei! Cold!” Phainon was too busy trying to guilt trip his lover that he didn’t notice the shower door opening and the water cutting off.

“Shut up, your dick is not that big” Mydei said as he poured more shower gel on Phainon naked back. Phainon let out a gasp at Mydei’s comment and at the coldness of Mydei’s hand spreading the gel on his back. Mydei couldn’t help but reach forward to poke Phainon’s puffy cheek, making the air inside his mouth travel to the other side. He did stop after Phainon started whining like a puppy once more, opting to focus on scrubbing Phainon’s back.

Phainon did quiet down a lot when he finally got Mydei’s hands on his body. Strong yet gentle hands began kneading into the knots on his back, applying gentle pressure along its glide. The model’s eyes were closed, helping him focus on those beautiful hands coaxing the tension knots on his back to loosen up. Having done this time and time again, Phainon’s body automatically controlled his breathing, deep inhales and slow exhales, letting all those tensions wash away. Titans above, Phainon really missed the feeling of Mydei’s hands on his body, both the innocent loving touches and the not so innocent ones.

Luck was smiling upon Phainon that night. Not only did he receive a back massage from Mydei, he also got his dose of serotonin. Like how all the fatigue melted away when his head hit the soft pillows, all of his complaints about Mydei “neglecting” him those pass few days melted away when he buried his face between his lover’s voluptuous and soft chest. The way too spoiled overgrown puppy was not satisfied with just simply laying on those pecs, not when those rosy buds are flaunting their existence near his mouth.

Mydei was engrossed in the book in his hand when he felt Phainon caressing his back. He was lying on a bean bag, enjoying Phainon’s warmth on top of him. The loving caress on his back was just a distraction from Phainon’s scheme, the book on his hand was left behind as Phainon manhandled him on to their bed in a blink of an eye. Before Mydei could even catch his breath, Phainon already had his mouth over a nipple. The silver-haired male closed his eyes shut, bracing himself for the fist that would descent on his head at any time.

The gentle caress on his head wasn’t what Phainon was expecting. He opened his eyes to peak at his lover’s expression and was met with such a gentle gaze making his heart went doki doki.

Chapter Summary

Their well deserved vacation

Finally, the day had come.

Phainon excitedly ran down the dock with Snowball and Maple chasing him, Mydei just let out a chuckle at his three energetic puppies. The blonde stood by their car, taking in the scenery of the dock and the salty breeze from the sea. His moment of quiet tranquility was interrupted as he saw Maple jumping into the water, followed by Phainon. Mydei thanked his past self for making sure Phainon put away his wallet and phone in their backpack. Both Maple and Phainon received the disappointed parent gaze when Phainon managed to catch the puppy.

Phainon got a towel thrown at his face when he opened his mouth for some excuses. Both soaking wet human and puppy were “quarantined” from their dry and clean partner. Only when Phainon was drying Maple’s fur that he noticed the dock they were at was strangely empty. No one was fishing, zero people walking around with a mini cooler strapped to their side to sell drinks and fruits. He did notice that every worker here was extremely polite when talking to his lover.

“Mydei, do you have the ferry tickets with you? I can’t find where you would buy one anywhere here” Phainon jogged over to Mydei, who was conversing with an older man dressed in a fancy butler suit. Mydei looked at him as if he was speaking in another language, then his eyes widened, realizing something. Whatever it was, it led to Mydei pulling Phainon into the sweetest kiss that month. Phainon was stunned lock by the suddenness of it.

“Have you already forgotten or do I have to take you out on more lavish and expensive dates?” Phainon jaws dropped when his brain finally made the connection between those words. It wasn’t a joke when their friends and others in the showbiz often referred to Mydei as the Crown Prince. The man carried himself with an air of nobility and royalty surrounding him and Mydei was practically swimming in money, being a talented actor and having 30% shares in his parent’s corporation have its benefit. Phainon seemed to be having troubles accepting the fact that Mydei was practically the sugar mommy/daddy in their relationship.

A soft hand grabbing his own brought Phainon back to reality. Mydei looked quite amused at his reaction toward the offhanded revelation that the fancy yacht docked next to them was his. If Mydei had already paid for their “tickets”, Phainon need to pull his weight in this vacation. And by that he meant carrying Mydei as often as possible, what kind of lover would he be if he let his princess walk on the damp walkway of the dock? Using the hold Mydei has on his hand, Phainon yanked the blonde towards him, so Mydei was pressed against his chest. The model already anticipated that yelling and retorts from Mydei the moment he lifted him in a bridal carry. Phainon’s solution to quiet him down was to press his lips against Mydei for a kiss. The blonde was protesting at first, tapping and hitting Phainon’s chest. But as soon as the model’s clever tongue slipped inside Mydei’s mouth, he slowly relaxed and melted into the kiss.

It was very fortunate that the dock was private property, Mydei would have slapped his lover with no hesitation if Phainon pulled such a stun in public.

Phainon was ushered off with his two puppies when Mydei decided to check out the yacht’s kitchen. Small spaces and three hyperactive creatures are a recipe for disaster. The two puppies were running around on the sun deck with Phainon watching over them to make sure none of them decided to take a dip in the ocean again. The atmosphere was perfect for a nap, cool breeze constantly blowing from the ocean, the calming sounds of waves hitting the side of the yacht, the sound of a boat engine slowly getting louder- Wait what?

Phainon leaned over the railing to see a small fishing boat that just arrived, a fisherman stepped out of the wheelhouse. The man seemed to be in his fifties, sporting a dark tan due to all his days spent on the sea. The man was looking around for someone until he looked up and made eyes contact with Phainon. The model didn’t expect to hear such a strong and deep voice from him.

“Oi city boy! Come down here and lend an old man a hand, will ya? I heard that my fishing buddy was here for a vacation, so I came over as fast as me old hunk of junk can run!”

Fishing buddy? Phainon didn’t expect this place to have more Mydei lore, especially one that he didn’t know about.
